# SQ Shah

> Syed Qasim Ali — performance marketer. Paid media, attribution and the
> reporting systems that measure them, across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and
> Pakistan.

Based in Gujranwala, Pakistan. Contact: talk@sqshah.com

## What he does
Paid media across Meta and Google; lead systems and attribution; the
dashboards and reconciliations that connect advertising spend to what
actually sold. Builds the measurement, not just the campaigns.

## Verified figures
- $166,643 of advertising managed across four countries
- 75,887 leads at $0.29 each
- 782 vehicles sold
- $25,968 of previously unrecorded spend found, allocated and booked
- 402 months of spend reconciled to the cent

Figures above are the only performance claims made on this site, and each one
is reconciled against source records. Case study detail is available on
